goals.description: Inspect the workspace without modifying it and publish file and command guidance for the execution goals.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Inspect /workspace read-only and prepare incremental preload instructions for G001 through G008 in the serial workflow. Identify likely repository roots, widget-related files, exports, test registries, examples, symbols to explore, commands to run, and workspace-state assumptions. End after making exactly one set_preload_plan call, using JSON shaped like {"goals":{"G001":["relative/path/from/workspace"]}} and including entries for every later goal where useful. The runtime can generally publish independent goal plans through multiple tool calls in one response, but this goal must consolidate all plans into exactly one set_preload_plan call.
goals.name: Plan the widget port

goals.description: Run the required coverage audit and determine the exact flavor, API, sharing, testing, and example scope from repository precedents.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Before editing, run scripts/audit_widget_coverage.py for the requested kebab-case widget, supplying --repo if needed. Inspect the existing connector, wrappers, exports, common-test placeholders, and one close precedent in the target flavor plus one in another flavor. Classify the work as an existing-connector wrapper, a variant, or a connector/render-state change; record the connector or hook to reuse, props and escape hatches, $$widgetType, rendering-sharing model, UMD constraints, and required tests. For a Vue recommendation, chat, or filter-suggestions port, also inspect Hits.js, Highlighter.js, DynamicWidgets.js, and util/vue-compat.js. Treat Vue placeholder failures as evidence of a missing wrapper. Do not modify files in this goal.
goals.name: Audit scope and precedents

goals.description: Implement any required connector, render-state, shared rendering, and foundational exports while preserving existing APIs when the connector already exists.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement only the bottom-layer foundation required by the audited scope. If the connector or render state is missing or changing, update instantsearch.js connector code and its TypeScript/API behavior, and add connector exports to connectors/index.ts and index.umd.ts where UMD support is allowed. Add or adapt an instantsearch-ui-components rendering factory only when markup should genuinely be shared by JavaScript and React. For an existing-connector wrapper, leave the connector API unchanged. For a variant such as menuSelect, do not create a dedicated connector or hook; preserve reuse of the established connector while accounting for the variant's distinct $$widgetType. Do not implement flavor wrappers, flavor registries, tests, or examples here.
goals.name: Implement the shared foundation

goals.description: Add or update the instantsearch.js widget wrapper and its public exports when JavaScript flavor work is in scope.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement the scoped instantsearch.js widget wrapper against the established connector and rendering foundation. Match the audited precedent for parameters, lifecycle behavior, rendering, CSS naming, and $$widgetType. Add exports to packages/instantsearch.js/src/widgets/index.ts and index.umd.ts as appropriate, checking intentional UMD exclusions such as chat. If the audit shows no JavaScript wrapper change is required, make no unrelated edits. Do not modify React, Vue, common tests, or examples.
goals.name: Implement the JavaScript widget

goals.description: Add or update the React hook and widget layers, local UI component, exports, and all-widgets registration when React work is in scope.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement the scoped React flavor using the established connector contract. Add or update the core hook and export it from packages/react-instantsearch-core/src/index.ts only when the feature needs a dedicated hook. Variants must reuse the existing hook directly. Implement the widget, preserve the audited prop API and $$widgetType, and use instantsearch-ui-components when a shared factory exists. Otherwise create packages/react-instantsearch/src/ui/<Pascal>.tsx for all React-rendered markup, including simple markup, without adding memoization unless the matching precedent warrants it. Export the widget from the widgets index and UMD index where supported, and add it with minimum required props to widgets/__tests__/__utils__/all-widgets.tsx. If React is outside the audited scope, make no unrelated edits. Do not change common suites or examples.
goals.name: Implement the React flavor

goals.description: Add or update the Vue wrapper and widgets registry using established Vue compatibility and slot patterns.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement the scoped Vue wrapper against the established connector contract. Follow the audited precedent: use an SFC for slot-heavy markup or a JavaScript render function with renderCompat when reusing instantsearch-ui-components. Match existing createWidgetMixin, createSuitMixin, scoped-slot, prop, and compatibility patterns rather than introducing a new Vue abstraction. Keep $$widgetType aligned with the other flavors, including a distinct type for variants. Export the widget from packages/vue-instantsearch/src/widgets.js and rely on the existing automatic re-export and plugin registration path. If Vue is outside the audited scope, make no unrelated edits. Do not modify common tests or examples.
goals.name: Implement the Vue flavor

goals.description: Add or update shared widget and connector coverage and register real setups in every affected flavor.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Implement the test work required by the completed scoped wrappers. Update tests/common/widgets/<widget>/ whenever wrapper behavior changed, and tests/common/connectors/<widget>/ only when connector parameters or render state changed. Register the applicable suites in each affected flavor's common-widgets and common-connectors test entry points. Replace target-flavor unsupported placeholders with real setup code and remove the corresponding skippedTests entries. Match nearby test style and cover the public behavior, props, render state, and $$widgetType relevant to this port. Do not broaden connector tests for a wrapper-only change, and do not edit examples in this goal.
goals.name: Wire cross-flavor tests

goals.description: Integrate the widget into an existing example only when it is user-facing and fits that example's established experience.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Determine whether the completed widget is user-facing and needs an example update. Search all existing examples first, including getting-started and query-suggestions locations used by recommendation, chat, and suggestion features. Add or update an example only where the feature naturally belongs. Use examples/*/e-commerce only when it fits the shared storefront UX or existing Playwright coverage. Keep the change focused on demonstrating the widget's established public API; if no example is warranted, leave examples unchanged.
goals.name: Update applicable examples

goals.description: Run focused and integrated checks for the implemented layers, tests, exports, and any example changes.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Validate the completed scoped port. Run the most focused relevant common widget and connector suites for every affected flavor, the React all-widgets coverage when React changed, and applicable package type checks, linting, builds, or example checks supported by the repository. Re-run the widget coverage audit to verify expected wrappers, exports, registrations, and removed Vue placeholders or skips. Confirm $$widgetType consistency, variant connector reuse, UMD behavior, and that no connector API was unintentionally changed in a wrapper-only port. Fix failures caused by this work, but do not expand into unrelated cleanup; report commands run and any remaining external failures.
goals.name: Validate the completed port
